name: Seedance 2.5 Draft To Video
description: Seedance 2.5 Draft To Video renders the 1080p final of a completed Seedance 2.5 draft job. It inherits the draft's prompt, inputs, duration, ratio and audio; output format and watermark can be set. Billed per million video output tokens at the 1080p rate, cheaper when the draft's input included video. A draft can be finalized for 7 days, and each final is charged separately.

input_schema.description: Render the 1080p final of a Seedance 2.5 draft.

draft_job_id.description: Id of a completed, undeleted Seedance 2.5 draft job of this organization, created in the last 7 days. The final inherits the draft's prompt, inputs, duration, ratio and audio. One draft can be finalized more than once; each final is its own paid job.
draft_job_id.title: Draft Job Id

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

input_schema.title: Seedance25DraftToVideoRequest
